newsitem.title: USA: U.S. CORN WEEKLY EXPORT SALES HIGHLIGHTS--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. CORN WEEKLY EXPORT SALES HIGHLIGHTS--USDA.

text.p: USDA corn export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 3,800 MT were primarily the result of increases for Mexico (96,400 MT), Egypt (62,100 MT), and Taiwan (24,300 MT) being partly offset by reductions for unknown destinations (210,600 MT) and Panama (22,800 MT).
Sales of 492,400 MT for delivery during the 1997/98 marketing year were primarily for Japan (288,400 MT), Taiwan (54,900 MT), unknown destinations (38,100 MT), and Saudi Arabia (35,000 MT).

Exports of 692,400 MT were one-tenth less than the week earlier, but 5 percent over the 4-week average. The principal destinations were Japan (201,300 MT), Taiwan (132,300 MT), Egypt (121,100 MT), Mexico (66,600 MT), and South Korea (54,300 MT).
